name: INTERCITY FIBER NETWORKS
notes:
Operational issues:
If you experience connectivity issues to INTERCITY 146908, please reach out to our Technical Operations contact below. When contacting please include the following info to reduce the troubleshooting time:

- Short description of the observed problem and impact
- SRC & DST IP address
- BGP peer information
- Traceroute or similar valuable debug output.
Please DO NOT contact policy addresses for operational support.

RPKI:
INTERCITY drops all routes identified as RPKI invalid on incoming eBGP sessions.
